annotations.title: Group / event visa screen: which nationalities in a group need a visa, ETA or e-Visa (up to 199 x 5)

description: Use when organising travel for a mixed-nationality group (conference, hackathon, team offsite, tour group): give destination (up to 5) and roster (nationalities with optional head counts, e.g. IN:12,NG:6,BR:5) and get per destination the head count needing no visa / online ETA or e-Visa / visa on arrival / embassy visa, the organiser action list (who needs invitation letters and an embassy appointment now), an over-stay check against start/end dates, Schengen notes and ETA portals, one row per nationality and a CSV string. Optional: destination, roster, start, end (YYYY-MM-DD). PAID: $0.250 per call, no API key or account, or free with a Trip Desk Pass. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base) or MPP over MCP (USDC.e on Tempo); an unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing. Bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/group-visa.

destination.description: Destination country, or up to 5 comma-separated (ISO alpha-2/alpha-3 or English name). Default (bare call): US

pass.description: Optional Trip Desk Pass token (tp1....). With a valid pass this call is not charged. Prefer setting it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>.

roster.description: Nationalities in the group, comma-separated, each optionally with :headcount (e.g. IN:12,NG:6,BR). Up to 199; "all" = every passport. Default (bare call): IN:12,NG:6,BR:5,DE:4,PH:4,CN:3,GB:3,KE:2,VN:2,MX:2

start.description: Optional arrival date YYYY-MM-DD (with end: over-stay check against each visa-free limit)
